deploy-bot: CHANGE WINDOW NOTICE: 2200 UTC — EU midnight slice starts in 45 minutes. Quiet window enforced from 2155-2300 UTC. Please post any exemption requests here. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/change-window-2026

release-manager: quick status — do we have any pending pins or last-minute release notes to surface?

maria: pinging to remind: we need model pin decision for recommendation flow. currently running redwood-recs:v3.4.1 in prod-canary. propose pin to v3.4.1 for the window, hold v3.5 for next week.

aj: @maria +1 on keeping v3.4.1 pinned. QA smoke on canary passed 10m ago: "all rec endpoints 200, p50 latency 82ms"

ops-oncall: requesting hotfix exemption? patch 3.4.2 contains cache TTL tweak that addresses transient OOMs in embeddings. Is it low risk?

maria: it's a 2-line config change, tested on staging. I vote allow as a microhotfix with restricted rollout (canary->10%->pin). Need release notes update and a rollback plan.

release-manager: OK. exemption approved under these rules: 1) no schema changes; 2) feature flag <= 10% for first 30m; 3) immediate rollback trigger on error rate > 0.5% or latency p95 > 1s. Post the quick rollforward/rollback steps here.

sam: rolling plan: deploy-bot, please start canary with these flags: --canary 10 --stagger 30s --tag microhotfix-3.4.2

deploy-bot: @sam: Received. Initiating canary deploy to prod-canary group. Command: ```/deploy prod --image redwood-recs:3.4.2 --canary 10 --pin model=redwood-recs:3.4.2 --stagger 30s --health-check /_health```

deploy-bot: CANARY STARTED — targets: 14 pods. Rolling update in progress. Monitor: https://redwood.internal/deploys/1754449999

liam: smoke hooks running. quick checks: embed pipeline samples OK, attribution logs normal. posting sample logs: ```2026-02-18T21:06:12Z INFO recs request ok id=...```

qa-lead: running audit prompts now. will post results in 10m. If any fuzziness in outputs compared to baseline, we hold.

aj: metrics look green so far. errors 0, p95 120ms, CPU spike negligible. :thumbsup:

ops-oncall: noted. I'll keep watch on infra alerts and retention. If OOMs reappear, we cut immediately.

deploy-bot: CANARY HEALTH UPDATE (t+8m): errors=0, p50=85ms, p95=130ms, replica_ok=14/14. No anomalies.

release-manager: good. @maria please update release notes with short bullet and link to config diff; add rollback steps (how to unpin + roll back image).

maria: done. notes: "Microhotfix: reduce cache TTL to avoid transient embedding OOMs (no model topology changes). Rollback: /deploy prod --image redwood-recs:3.4.1 --pin model=redwood-recs:3.4.1 or run deploy-bot rollback command." Link: https://redwood.internal/releases/3.4.2

qa-lead: audit finished — no semantic regressions detected on our eval set (100 prompts). tagging :eyes: for longer tail checks but safe to proceed.

deploy-bot: CANARY PROMOTE: proceeding to 50% as scheduled. Update: 50% rollout started.

sam: remind ops to keep the quiet window until full rollout completes. once at 100% hold for 30m observation before unpin decision.

ops-oncall: acknowledged. staying in the channel for the window.

deploy-bot: ROLLOUT COMPLETE: 100% applied. health: errors=0, p95=135ms. Pin applied to model=redwood-recs:3.4.2.

release-manager: post-roll observations: small p95 uptick but within SLO. Holding pin for remainder of quiet window. If stable at end of window, we'll keep pin and publish release note to customers. Anyone object?

liam: no objections. recommend we schedule a follow-up regression run overnight to double-check embedding distribution drift.

maria: agreed. I'll schedule the regression and share results by 0400 UTC.

qa-lead: thumbs up.

release-manager: excellent. closing this thread after window end. thanks all for quick coordination. :party_parrot:

deploy-bot: CHANGE WINDOW CLOSED at 2300 UTC. If rollback required, open an incident channel and tag @ops-oncall. Goodbye for now.
